title: Add one-off schedule support (run-at timestamp)
description: Support one-off scheduled runs via explicit timestamp (e.g., --at 2026-02-13 08:00), stored as single-run and auto-disable/remove after execution. Cron is 5-field only; need first-class once.
close_reason: Implemented one-off schedule support with --at flag for CLI, ScheduleKind enum for models, and backend support for systemd/internal

title: Support pause until date feature
description: Allow schedules to be paused until a specific date/time, automatically re-enabling when that time passes

title: Make internal backend command execution portable across platforms
description: Internal backend always invokes /bin/sh -c, which fails on Windows. Select shell based on target_os (cmd.exe /C on Windows, sh -c elsewhere) and add tests for shell selection.

title: Centralize cron expression validation across CLI and storage
description: Cron expressions are inconsistently validated (add validates, edit does not; backends assume 5 fields). Add a core validator that accepts 5-field cron, normalizes for cron crate validation, and use it in Storage::save_schedule and CLI edit/add to reject invalid cron early.

title: Add byt schedule wrapper commands
description: Implement byt schedule add/list/remove commands that wrap skdlr CLI for cross-repo scheduling

title: Add HTTP API for octo integration
description: Create skdlr-api crate with REST endpoints for schedule management, enabling octo dashboard integration

title: Implement TUI for schedule management
description: Create skdlr-tui with interactive schedule list, add/edit forms, and execution log viewer using ratatui

title: Implement MCP server for AI agent integration
description: Create skdlr-mcp crate providing MCP tools for listing, creating, and managing schedules from AI agents

title: Enable SQLite foreign key enforcement
description: SQLite foreign keys are not enabled by default; ON DELETE CASCADE in runs table is currently ineffective. Enable PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON on connection init.

title: Validate schedule identifiers and fields to prevent path traversal/unit injection
description: Schedule names and related fields are used in file paths and unit/plist content without validation. Add core validation to restrict schedule names to safe ASCII (e.g., [A-Za-z0-9_-]+), reject path separators/control characters in name/description/workdir/env keys/values, and surface errors before writing backend files or storage.

title: Parse journalctl output for run history on systemd
description: Implement proper parsing of journalctl JSON output to populate Run records in the systemd backend

title: Remove unwraps in launchd backend path handling
description: Launchd backend uses plist.to_str().unwrap() which can panic for non-UTF-8 paths. Return a structured error instead to keep library code panic-free.

title: Fix systemd user dir fallback path expansion
description: SystemdBackend::new falls back to PathBuf::from(~/.config), which does not expand ~ and can create invalid paths. Use home_dir-based fallback (e.g., /home/wismut/.config) or AppPaths logic.

title: Avoid silent data corruption in storage row parsing
description: Storage::row_to_schedule/row_to_run use unwrap_or_default for UUID/date/env JSON parsing, which silently substitutes defaults. Return explicit parse errors instead so corrupted DB data is surfaced and handled.
